pages.text: Locusts eat grass and crops, then wait before eating again. Most wait minutes between meals.

pages.name: Grasshopper
pages.text: Plains and forests. Grass, wheat, carrots within 8 blocks.

pages.name: Red
pages.text: Deserts. Grass and beetroots within 8 blocks.

pages.name: Dream
pages.text: Also eats potatoes, within 16 blocks. Not seen in the wild.

pages.name: Golden
pages.text: One in a hundred. Any mature crop within 32 blocks, and it hardly waits.

Two golden parents always have a golden child, and any other pair may, one time in a hundred, do so too.$(br2)Golden locusts eat golden vegetables. All the others breed on flowers.$(br2)An adult drops a snack when killed, and the Collector villager buys grasshopper, red and dream snacks for emeralds.
